errors.INVALID_INPUT: The input is malformed or impossible.
errors.OUT_OF_DOMAIN: The input is valid but outside what this method or model covers.
errors.UNIT_MISMATCH: The unit does not fit this field, or it is ambiguous.
errors.DID_NOT_CONVERGE: The calculation reached its iteration limit without converging.
errors.DEGENERATE_GEOMETRY: The geometry is undefined or degenerate.
errors.NO_SOLUTION: The problem is well formed but has no answer.
errors.ASSET_UNAVAILABLE: Required reference data is not loaded.
errors.ASSET_INTEGRITY: Reference data failed its integrity check.
errors.LIMIT_EXCEEDED: The request is over a size, time, or memory limit.
errors.UNSUPPORTED: The tool is unknown or not available here.
errors.INTERNAL: Something went wrong inside geoprims. Please report it.

ABOVE_ALTITUDE_CEILING.message: The height is above the altitude ceiling you set (default 400 ft AGL).

ABOVE_MAX_HOLDING_SPEED.message: The speed is above the maximum holding speed for this altitude.

ABOVE_VNE.message: The airspeed is above VNE, the never-exceed speed.

ACCURACY_DEGRADED.message: Accuracy is lower than usual for this input.

ADJUSTMENT_TEST_FAILED.message: The adjustment failed its statistical test.

ALGORITHM_FALLBACK.message: A different algorithm was used; see the model field.

AMBIGUOUS_INPUT.message: The input was ambiguous; one reading was chosen.

BELOW_HORIZON.message: The target is below the horizon.

BELOW_STALL_SPEED.message: The airspeed is below the stall speed for this configuration.

BELOW_TERRAIN.message: Part of the path is below the terrain surface.

BEYOND_HORIZON.message: Part of the camera's view reaches the horizon, so that part of the footprint is unbounded.

BUFFER_ACCURACY.message: The buffer's boundary strays from the distance by more than its tolerance.

CANNOT_RETURN_INTO_WIND.message: The aircraft cannot return against this wind with the energy left.

CAUTION_RANGE.message: The airspeed is in the caution range, between VNO and VNE.

CENTROID_OUTSIDE.message: The centroid lies outside the shape.

CIVIL_TWILIGHT_APPROXIMATED.message: Civil twilight was computed as the sun 6° below the horizon, not read from the Air Almanac.

COMPASS_BLACKOUT_ZONE.message: Magnetic compasses are unreliable here: the horizontal field is too weak.

COMPASS_CAUTION_ZONE.message: Magnetic compasses may be unreliable here: the horizontal field is weak.

COVERING_OVER_BUDGET.message: The covering needs more cells than the budget allows.

CURVE_CALL_INCOMPLETE.message: The curve call is missing elements.

C_RATE_EXCEEDED.message: The battery discharge rate is above its rated C-rate.

DECLINATION_POLE_CONVENTION.message: Declination at the pole follows a convention.

DEFORMATION_ZONE.message: The point is in a zone of active crustal deformation.

DRY_AIR_ASSUMED.message: Dry air was assumed; humidity would raise density altitude.

EQUIVALENT_FOCAL_LENGTH.message: A 35 mm equivalent focal length was used.

EXPERIMENTAL_TOOL.message: This tool is experimental and not yet fully verified.

FLAT_CELL.message: The cell is flat, so it has no aspect.

FLY_OVER_RECOMMENDED.message: The turn is too sharp to fly by; fly over the waypoint instead.

FOOT_OUTSIDE_SEGMENT.message: The closest point is outside the segment.

FRAME_MISMATCH.message: The inputs use different reference frames.

GEOMETRY_INVALID.message: The geometry is not valid; a repaired version is returned.

HEURISTIC_PEUKERT.message: A Peukert correction was applied; it describes lithium packs poorly.

HOTSPOT_IN_FRAME.message: The sun's hotspot falls inside the camera frame.

INSUFFICIENT_CHECKPOINTS.message: There are too few checkpoints to test accuracy.

LEGACY_UNIT.message: The US survey foot was deprecated by NIST and NOAA on January 1, 2023.

LOAD_LIMIT_EXCEEDED.message: A weight or load limit is exceeded.

LONGITUDE_UNDEFINED.message: Longitude is undefined at a pole.

LOW_ACCURACY_TRANSFORM.message: The chosen transformation has low accuracy.

MODEL_EXTRAPOLATED.message: The model is used outside its validity window.

NOMINAL_VALUE_USED.message: A nominal planning value was used; the actual value varies.

NON_METRIC_CALL.message: The call has no bearing and distance (a monument, adjoiner, or natural boundary); it is kept as text.

NON_OFFICIAL_DATUM.message: This datum or zone is not official yet (beta).

NO_REDUNDANCY.message: There are no redundant measurements to check the result.

OBSERVATION_OLD.message: The weather observation is old for planning.

ORTHOMETRIC_AS_ELLIPSOIDAL.message: An orthometric height was treated as ellipsoidal.

OUTPUT_TRUNCATED.message: The result is longer than the tool returns, so part of it is left out.

OUTSIDE_AREA_OF_USE.message: The point is outside the area the transformation was derived for.

OUTSIDE_CG_ENVELOPE.message: The center of gravity is outside the envelope you entered.

OUTSIDE_ZONE_EXTENT.message: The point is outside the zone's usual extent.

OVERLAP_BELOW_TARGET.message: Image overlap is below the target.

PENTAGON_DISTORTION.message: The result touches an H3 pentagon, where distortion is higher.

PERFECT_CLOSURE.message: The traverse closes perfectly, which is unusual for field data.

PLANAR_ON_GEOGRAPHIC.message: Planar math was applied to geographic coordinates.

PRISMOIDAL_MIDDLE_AREA_AVERAGED.message: The prismoidal middle area was averaged from the end areas.

RESECTION_UNSTABLE.message: The resection geometry is weak or unstable.

RHUMB_REACHES_POLE.message: The rhumb line reaches a pole.

RUNWAY_HEADING_APPROXIMATE.message: The runway heading was taken from the runway number.

STATION_VARIATION_DIFFERS.message: The station's published variation differs from the model.

SUN_BELOW_HORIZON.message: The sun is below the horizon.

SUSPECT_VALUE.message: A value looks unusual; check it.

TERRAIN_NOT_CONSIDERED.message: Terrain and obstacles are not considered.

TRIGGER_TOO_FAST.message: The camera cannot trigger this fast.

VARIABLE_WIND.message: The wind direction varies; components are the worst case over its range.

VISIBILITY_BELOW_MINIMUM.message: The visibility is below the minimum the guidance recommends.

WAYPOINT_OUTSIDE_GEOFENCE.message: A waypoint is outside the geofence.

WEB_MERCATOR_CLAMPED.message: Latitude was clamped to the Web Mercator limit.
